records.label: Veil Sixclaw the Outcast

facts.text: Swartt and Bluefen's son, six left claws, rescued as infant and raised chiefly by young Bryony. Poisons, steals, assaults and deliberately seals carers in tunnel; later frees Bryony and interposes against javelin, dies in her lap. Final moral interpretations differ; preserve acts, caregiver failure, prejudice and accountability independently.
